test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

I said to the postman, “Is there a letter for me?”

options.text: I asked the postman was there a letter for me.
I asked the postman that is there a letter for me.
I asked the postman if there was a letter for me.
I asked the postman if there is a letter for me.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is '__​I asked the postman if there was a letter for me.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
 

 
 
I said to the postman

 
 
 
Is there a letter for me.

 
 
 

__Reporting clause__ __Reported speech__

__
 
• When the reporting speech is in Simple present tense then all the speech Changes to Simple past tense.

 
 
• is----- was
 
 
 
• Said to of the reporting verb changed into **asked**.
 
• Replace comma (,) and inverted commas (" ") with the conjunction '**if**'.
 
• Treat reported speech as an affirmative sentence.

 

​So, the final sentence is: ​I asked the postman if there was a letter for me.

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *

__What is Direct & Indirect Speech?__

 
• 
 Direct speech – reporting the message of the speaker in the exact words as spoken by him.

 
 
• Direct speech example: Maya said, "I am busy now".
 
 
 
• 
 Indirect speech: reporting the message of the speaker in our own words 

 
 
• Indirect speech example: Maya said that she was busy then.
 
 

e9:T
